record.synthesis_method: mixing of components in a glass tube with heating and magnetic stirring
record.evidence_quote: It is best visible for T = 269 K between 1 Hz and 10 kHz where dc reaches values around 210-7 -1 cm-1.
record.notes: The sentence does not name the composition; x = 0.6 is inferred from the Fig. 3 caption (typical spectra of HEX1-xOCTx with x = 0.6 and 1 mol% LiPF6). The value is garbled in the PDF text: the exponent and the unit (Ω^-1 cm^-1) are corrupted, and the reported value is read as about 2x10^-7 S/cm. Temperature converted from 269 K. Conductivity is a dc value from the spectra, not a separately fitted bulk or grain-boundary value. Other conductivity values appear only in Figs. 4-6 and were not recorded.
